title: The Current of the Coral Triangle
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Astrid Reyes, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
